prompts.transfer:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single production home-card illustration for a macOS utility called Nearby Transfer. Input reference is ONLY the pencil/crayon/paper art style, not its gauge subject. Create a NEW distinct composition. A warm ivory paper canvas, approximately square with a slightly landscape 256:236 proportion. Fill about 88% of the canvas with the main illustration, compact and clearly legible at 200px.
Communicate TWO NEARBY MACS exchanging files AND clipboard content. Two small charming hand-drawn open laptops, lower left blue and lower right mint green, simple graphite outlines with naturally irregular strokes; neither a detailed computer mockup nor app chrome. Their screens show a tiny colorful mountain-photo tile on one side and a few large pencil text strokes on the other. Above/between the laptops, two bold curved directional arrows: blue goes from left to right, purple goes back from right to left, forming a spacious exchange loop. A folded-corner document and a small photo visibly travel along one arc; a small clipboard sheet with two graphite text strokes travels along the return arc. Two subtle blue proximity signal marks between the two ends. Main meaning at a glance: nearby devices exchanging files and clipboard. Keep arrows clean, complete and unambiguous.
Same real colored-pencil/crayon grain, imperfect graphite outlines, restrained sky blue/purple/mint/yellow, tactile light paper and tasteful handmade charm as the reference. Flat front/very slight perspective, no strong drop shadows. No text, no letter labels, no numbers, no logos, no outer card border, no title/captions, no UI buttons. No generic folder-to-page import illustration. Avoid extra objects and tiny decorative clutter. This is a module illustration, not a full app screenshot.
prompts.file:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single production home-card illustration for a macOS utility called File Actions. Input reference is ONLY the pencil/crayon/paper style, not its gauge subject. Create a NEW compact composition on warm ivory paper, approximately square, slightly landscape 256:236. Main illustration fills 88% of the canvas and remains clear at 200px. Explain one file being processed: format conversion, image compression and resizing. It must be visually distinct from device-to-device transfer.
One dominant folded-corner paper file, slightly left of center, occupies most of the height. Its upper half has a lovely blue-sky/mountain/sun image, its lower half has three graphite text strokes, expressing both pictures and documents. At the file's lower front is a compact row of THREE little pencil operation tiles, like tools attached to this file, with restrained blue/purple/green fills: first tile shows two folded-corner mini pages with the clear format labels 'PNG' and 'JPG' and a small turning arrow; middle tile shows a simple folded-corner page labeled 'MD'; third tile shows a small colorful photo with four inward-pointing corner arrows to show compress/shrink. A short blue branching connection from the main file to the tool row reinforces that these are operations on ONE file. Arrange the three tiles wide enough to read, no huge unused margins. The source file and tools form one cohesive, sturdy silhouette, rather than two generic line documents with a straight arrow.
Faithfully match real colored-pencil/crayon grain, imperfect graphite outlines, restrained sky blue/purple/mint/yellow, light paper and tasteful handmade charm of the reference. Flat drawing, no glossy gradients, no heavy shadows. Only text allowed is the exact short format labels PNG, JPG and MD; no descriptive prose, headings, keyboard keys, logos, computer screens, outer card frame or extra ornamental clutter. Not a vector icon, not a full UI screenshot.
